visualizerParams.title: Bug Squasher: Clearing Keeps Only That Bit
visualizerParams.problemDescription: Clearing bit 2 of 255 should give 251, but the program prints 4.

solution.explanation: AND with a single-bit mask keeps only that bit and wipes the rest. To clear one bit you AND with the inverted mask ~(1u << 2), which keeps everything except that bit.
